Description: Elevation in metres above mean sea level (AMSL)
QC_Rule: No nulls (nodata value must be set — use -9999 or source nodata; not 0); all valid cells must have values within expected elevation range for Nigeria

Description: NoData value — must be explicitly set
QC_Rule: Must be set before any derivative processing; do not use 0 as nodata (valid elevations near sea level exist in study area)
Must be EPSG:4326; verify with gdalinfo before processing derivatives
Must match selected source resolution (3 arc-sec = 0.000833 degrees; 1 arc-sec = 0.000278 degrees)

Description: Pixel height in decimal degrees (negative for north-up raster)
QC_Rule: Must be negative (north-up); magnitude must match Pixel_Size_X

Description: Western bounding extent in decimal degrees
Eastern bounding extent in decimal degrees
Southern bounding extent in decimal degrees
Northern bounding extent in decimal degrees
Minimum valid elevation value in raster
QC_Rule: Must be >= -10m (coastal/delta areas may be near sea level); flag if < -10

Description: Maximum valid elevation value in raster
QC_Rule: Must be <= 2500m for Nigeria study area; flag if > 2500 (possible error or extreme highland)

Description: Whether hydrologic conditioning was applied and method used
